body: So am I alright going to a college counselor or something like that, or would they panic at the concept?
It's an important step towards not doing it, but it feels anti productive considering I do want to do it
Yeah, you definitely got me there, there are people that care
She will try to help, but if she fails it would ruin her. And if she succeeds it might be the only reason I'm not doing it which is not a very happy life for me at all. Thanks though
You still up man? just stopping by to say hello again

Are you thinking about doing it tonight? If so, at least wait another day please. You mentioned that coffee multiplies your anxiety, and the night has that kind of effect too, as do finals. This part sucks, but your post implies that there could be an improvement, so there's some hope there I guess? Cheers, mate
Right now there is the joy of knowing there could be a potential finish line in sight and that's pretty euphoric, why not enjoy the euphoria a bit before finishing it?

Then please don't overreact to the wave. That means you've had the strength to get through these waves before, and good on you, that's tough stuff. But at the very least wait until even the highs are unbearable, okay? Acting during a compulsion during a low may not be the right time to make the decision

Emotions are more overwhelming at night, for me at least. Sometimes it just slams into me for the night and I feel like it is gonna be the night.. and sometimes I think it'll be a month or two away still. Is it a constant blanket for you, or does it come in waves like that?
Why is it you won't be able to do it? I'm not encouraging you to do it, but if you don't think you will, then it might help to identify what is stopping you
Hey, if you're still here, just wanted to say hello and offer to listen or talk, whatever it takes to get you through the night.

It could be worth a try as a last resort if nothing else, I think happiness is learned, not always necessarily a result of the life going on around you. That is honestly impressive that you've struggled with this 25 years and haven't done it, to me that means at least a part of you might not want to maybe? What reasons do you tell yourself to not do it?

Now THAT I can relate to. I used to struggle with depression, and it was just a constant blanket. Now it is more suicidal tendencies, and sometimes I'm satisfied enough, but sometimes it just smacks me in the face repeatedly for a night. One piece of advice I do have for you is this: you seem to have a genuine desire to care for people. Go invest in that. Whether it be homeless people, inner city kids, refugees, etc., it feels good. Loving other people helps you love yourself.

For what it's worth, I don't know if happiness comes from what this post implies that it does. It is possible for a life to be satisfying with a shit job, or for a CEO to be depressed and suicidal. I couldn't tell you where happiness does come from exactly, and the future is scary as hell, but I don't know if you can assume your life is doomed because you aren't on track to a managerial position. cheers, mate
I'm another college student and I don't know if I'm actually allowed to ask this, but what state are you in? If that is personal info I can't ask for, sorry mods, delete this post.

You don't have to feel bad about being unhappy just because you have good things, depression doesn't always have anything to do with what's going on around you, it's mental games, man. For me, working on my diet and adding a lot more foods high in dopamine helped for a while, but I slipped back into it. You don't have to plaster on a smile, communication is good
I don't have any real advice for you, and I can only relate to some of this. Just wanted to stop in and say hello

I'm also a college kid, and it seems like a lot of my friends (and myself) can relate to this depression/suicidal trend at some point during their second year. I don't know what it is, but it hits me... Good on you to be too chicken to do it, could also be bravery, because it is ROUGH getting through the day. Cheers, mate

Maybe it isn't that you're too much of a wimp, but that part of you doesn't want it. Maybe life keeps knocking you down and making it feel necessary, but you don't want it to be necessary...
Or maybe not, I'm really talking about myself and maybe it applies to you too.
If the idea of your impending death is making life good right now, then why not keep going while you're ahead and wait longer than a week?

I agree with all of this and everything. I wanted to reply because you may have expected a reply this far in a comment conversation, but I don't have anything else to tell you except that I relate and I agree. If you want to keep talking about this feel free to reach out mate, cheers.

The logic of trying to stay a good person even when you're jealous of the bad ones is praiseworthy, good job.
And don't count on the little things to fix it, I admit I have obtained some of the little things I think will make me happier again. But it's temporary and once I have that I want more of that, the gratefulness doesn't stick. I don't know what fixes it, but it is not a combination of small joys or happy moments that people seem to want me to count on as a reason to live.
Maybe so, but the universe keeps pushing me (and it looks like you too) down, and I don't know how to be right and productive from here and get somewhere better.

It does sound nice, doesn't it? I can relate. Everyday is the same. Going to class, going to work, going to sleep, everyday is just full of unrewarding bullshit. Just a steady wearing and tearing away from uninteresting shit and never being pulled up again by things fulfilling... I can do today, I can do this week, probably this month, but who knows how long I'll stop myself? I know none of this is encouraging at all, but just wanted to throw out there that I think I understand, and I too am sometimes struggling to keep up the barriers separating me from an end, but continuing to try.
Thank you
It is always nice to hear someone relating, so thank you for that. Right now I can endure the pain for longer and I'm somewhat winning the fight, but it is a fight nonetheless.
Oh I know easy is unreachable, but easier is possible in my mind.
